name: Village
howToFind: Generates in plains, desert, savanna, taiga, snowy plains and meadow biomes - walk and look, or use /locate structure minecraft:village_plains (each variant has its own ID)
Cartographers never map villages: exploration is the way
On Bedrock, villages are far more common than in Java
loot: Hay bales (9 wheat each) and farm crops
House chests: food, tools, saplings, armor
Weaponsmith chests: iron, obsidian, sometimes diamonds
Beds and workstations you can take for your own trading hall
dangers: Zombie sieges and pillager raids (Bad Omen)
Iron golems defend villagers - and you, if your reputation is good
Zombie villagers spawn in abandoned (zombie) villages, which have cobwebs and no doors... free curing practice
tips: Ring the bell to make villagers hide - and to see the village center for farm building.
Sleep before midnight on your first night: a zombie siege can wipe a village before you get to trade.
Abandoned villages (2% of villages) have no loot penalty and plenty of cobweb-string.
keywords: village minecraft find loot bell raid zombie village

name: Stronghold
howToFind: Throw eyes of ender: they fly toward the nearest stronghold. Follow them until they start diving into the ground, then dig down
Triangulate: throw from two spots a few hundred blocks apart and walk to where the flight lines cross - saves eyes
Java: 128 strongholds generate in rings around the world origin. Bedrock: unlimited, some directly under villages
loot: Libraries: enchanted books (including treasure enchantments), paper and books
Corridor and altar chests: ender pearls, iron, apples, eyes of ender
The End portal room: 12 frames, each with a 10% chance to be pre-filled - expect 0-2 eyes already in place
dangers: Silverfish spawner in the portal room - break it or light it before activating the portal
Silverfish hide in infested stone bricks throughout the structure
Easy to get lost: place torches on one side to mark the way back
tips: Bring 12+ eyes of ender: some for the trip, some for the frames.
The portal room sometimes generates without a frame (rare generation bug): find another stronghold instead of raging.
Mine straight down only after digging a staircase - strongholds love to open into caves and ravines.
keywords: stronghold find eyes of ender end portal silverfish library loot

name: Ancient City
howToFind: Generates in the deep dark biome around Y=-52, most often under mountains (jagged peaks, windswept hills)
Dig down from a mountain or find a deep cave that reaches deepslate levels
loot: Echo shards (craft the recovery compass - points to your last death spot)
Swift Sneak enchanted books (only source in the game)
Enchanted golden apples, disc fragments (Music Disc 5), sculk catalysts
Reinforced deepslate frame in the center: unbreakable, purely decorative (no hidden portal)
dangers: Sculk sensors hear you walk, place and break blocks - sculk shriekers summon the Warden on the fourth warning
The Warden: 500 HP, sonic boom attack that goes through walls and armor. You are not meant to fight it
Darkness effect pulses whenever shriekers trigger
tips: Bring stacks of wool: walking on wool is silent, and you can wall off sensors before looting a chest.
Break every shrieker you can reach AFTER its fourth-scream cooldown resets - a shrieker can only summon one Warden per 4 screams.
If the Warden spawns: stand still, let it sniff past, and leave the way you came. It digs back down after 60 calm seconds.
keywords: ancient city deep dark warden loot echo shard swift sneak reinforced deepslate

name: Bastion Remnant
howToFind: Generates in every Nether biome except basalt deltas
Four types: bridges, hoglin stables, housing units and the treasure room - the treasure bastion has the giant gold-block pyramid and lava pool
loot: Netherite upgrade smithing template: guaranteed in the treasure room chest (1.20+) - you need 7 diamonds to duplicate each one
Ancient debris, netherite scraps and sometimes a netherite ingot (treasure room)
Pigstep music disc, snout banner pattern, gilded blackstone
Gold blocks by the dozen, especially in the treasure bastion
dangers: Piglins attack anyone without gold armor or anyone opening chests and mining gold - wear one gold piece and distract them with gold ingots dropped elsewhere
Piglin brutes: 50 HP, no fear of gold armor, huge axe damage. They do not respawn - clear them first
Magma cube spawners under the treasure bastion lava pool
tips: Loot chests without angering piglins: break the block under the chest, place a hopper feeding a new chest, and take the items from the hopper - piglins only get angry if you open or break the container directly.
Hoglins in the stables bastion are a free porkchop farm if you block them in.
Never dig straight down in a bastion: lava pockets and brute fall-traps are everywhere.
keywords: bastion remnant nether loot piglin brute netherite upgrade template pigstep treasure room

name: Nether Fortress
howToFind: Generates in strips running north-south: travel east or west (X axis) and you will cross one eventually
Look for the dark nether brick bridges over lava seas - render distance high helps
loot: Nether wart growing beside stairwells - the start of all brewing
Blaze spawners: blaze rods for brewing stands and eyes of ender
Fortress chests: diamonds, saddles, gold and iron horse armor, golden swords
Wither skeleton skulls: 2.5% base drop (Java +1% per Looting level, Bedrock +2%)
dangers: Wither skeletons inflict Wither: your hearts turn black and drain. Milk cures it
Blazes set you on fire from range - fire resistance potions turn the fight trivial
One wrong step off a bridge into lava is the classic hardcore run ender
tips: Wither skeletons only spawn inside the fortress bounding box - mark it before building a skull farm.
A Looting III sword nearly doubles skull rates; bring one before committing to Wither farming.
Blaze spawners: cage the spawner with torches on all faces to pause it while you build the farm.
keywords: nether fortress find blaze spawner wither skeleton skull nether wart loot

name: Trial Chambers
howToFind: Underground structures of copper and tuff, most common between Y=-20 and Y=40 in the deepslate layers
Buy a trial explorer map from a journeyman cartographer (12 emeralds + compass)
loot: Vaults opened with trial keys: enchanted books, emeralds, armor trims (bolt and flow)
Ominous vaults (need ominous trial keys): the heavy core for crafting the mace, flow banner pattern
Breeze rods from breezes: wind charges and mace crafting
Music discs Precipice and Creator, pottery sherds exclusive to the chambers
dangers: Trial spawners scale with player count and spawn waves of breezes, bogged, slimes, silverfish and more
Breezes jump huge distances and their wind charges knock you off ledges into melee range of everything else
Bad Omen turns trial spawners ominous: better loot, much harder waves (potion-throwing, enchanted gear)
tips: Each player can open each vault once per structure - bring friends, everyone gets loot.
Trial spawners rest 30 minutes after a clear: the chambers are a renewable dungeon you can farm.
Bring a shield and slow-falling: wind charge knockback near the chasm rooms is the main killer.
keywords: trial chambers 1.21 breeze vault trial key heavy core mace ominous
